items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: At that time I played drums with him.

ctx.x: Can we stop with the Navy? Because I'm confused on something. Did you ever go out of town and play with bands?
That's all I ever did. Sam Morgan, I can tell you a lot of things.
No, I mean bands from Missouri or Mississippi. Did you ever move away from New Orleans?
